说明: 修复三个已确认原版字段在现有 Swift 模型导入、编辑、导出和保存后丢失的问题；仅保留字段，不代表子正文、批量正文协议已执行或完整 schema 已通过验收。
defaultAbsentOrNullBehavior: Optional fields remain nil and are omitted from synthesized export; existing legacy sources gain no default keys.
textBehavior: Preserve valid text including empty/whitespace-only strings, line endings and decomposed Unicode; reject malformed field types with a field/reason-only diagnostic.
batchSizeBehavior: Preserve signed Int32 integers and integer strings; truncate finite numeric fractions toward zero as the original Gson does. Reject values outside Int32 range instead of wrapping. Invalid forms produce nil and a field/reason-only diagnostic, preserving other content-rule fields.

originalDesktopObservation.scope: Actual original ContentRule and GsonExtensions compiled/run on desktop with only Parcelable/Parcelize platform stubs. These observations do not execute the Swift decoder or the Android application.

covers: object/double-encoded rule across three existing import shapes

limits: No Swift/iOS compilation or execution on Windows; all 23 Swift executions await the source-specific cloud check.
Malformed optional fields are logged and omitted while other rule fields survive; original Gson rejects the malformed rule.
Original Gson Int overflow can wrap; this decoder explicitly drops values outside Int32 range. This is a disclosed protective difference, not full parity.
No new evaluator, host, parser route or source store is introduced; traditional product reading still uses JSC.
